subject.title: Install ClawHub packages for new Claw agents

question: May an individual Claw manifest install or reuse a process-wide plugin through ordinary add-plan consent, or must shared plugins require a separate host- or Scout-level grant?
rationale: Plugins execute with host-level trust and can change behavior for every agent on the Gateway, so implementation correctness cannot determine the permanent authorization and isolation policy.

options.title: Require Shared-Host Grant
options.body: Keep plugin packages, but require explicit shared-resource authorization distinct from ordinary per-Claw add consent.

options.title: Accept Add-Plan Consent
options.body: Treat the reviewed integrity-bound add plan as sufficient operator authorization for process-wide plugin mutation.

options.title: Defer Plugin Packages
options.body: Ship workspace-local skill support first and pause process-wide plugin mutation until stronger isolation or resource-sharing semantics exist.

recommendation.title: Require Shared-Host Grant
recommendation.body: Keep plugin packages, but require explicit shared-resource authorization distinct from ordinary per-Claw add consent.

likelyOwner.reason: The shared plugin-management and uninstall service is the primary current enforcement point for the selected authorization policy.
